Subject: Upcoming migration window — impact to support SLAs?

Hi Priya,

Quick heads up — Banzai is planning a large data-plane migration over the weekend of Jul 3-5. Our infra team expects elevated error rates during the cutover window and we want to understand how Redwood will handle P1/P2 routing and on-call coverage. Specific asks:

- Will P1 responses remain within our contracted 1 hour during the migration?
- Can we expect an extended P2 response window overnight during the cutover?
- If we see an outage, what is the escalation path (who will be on-call and who will be the exec contact)?

We need a written variance/acknowledgement from Redwood to share with our internal stakeholders. If possible, please send a proposed mutual action plan and any temporary SLA variances.

Thanks,
